options.text: Immediately deploy earthmovers, divert traffic to alternate state highways, and issue emergency advisories

options.label: C
options.text: Permanently ban all tourist travel to the Western Ghats

options.label: D
options.text: Suspend all district officials in charge of highways

questions.explanation: Action must be proportionate and immediate: clear landslide, provide diversions, issue public advisories.

questions.subject: General Mental Ability
questions.text: A confidential file detailing pending land acquisitions is requested informally by an MLA's aide over the phone. What should the Assistant Commissioner do?

options.label: A
options.text: Hand over the file immediately to avoid political friction

options.label: B
options.text: Politely decline and advise the requester to seek information through formal official channels or RTI

options.label: C
options.text: Leak the document secretly to the media

options.label: D
options.text: Destroy the file to prevent scrutiny

questions.explanation: Public officers must maintain confidentiality and direct requests to lawful statutory channels.
questions.label: expected

questions.subject: General Mental Ability
questions.text: What is the HCF of two numbers if their product is 2,160 and their LCM is 360?
questions.explanation: $\text{Product} = \text{LCM} \times \text{HCF} \implies \text{HCF} = 2160 / 360 = 6$.
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: General Mental Ability
questions.text: If 15 men can complete a civil drainage canal in 20 days, how many days will 25 men take to complete the same work?
questions.explanation: $M_1 D_1 = M_2 D_2 \implies 15 \times 20 = 25 \times D_2 \implies D_2 = 300 / 25 = 12\text{ days}$.
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: General Mental Ability
questions.text: A shopkeeper marks an article 40% above its cost price and allows a discount of 20% on the marked price. What is his net profit percentage?
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: General Mental Ability
questions.text: A sum of money doubles itself in 5 years at simple interest. In how many years will it become 4 times the principal at the same rate?
questions.explanation: Doubles $\implies SI = P$ in 5 yrs. 4 times $\implies SI = 3P$. Time $= 3 \times 5 = 15\text{ years}$.
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: General Mental Ability
questions.text: The difference between compound interest (compounded annually) and simple interest on Rs. 20,000 at 5% per annum for 2 years is:
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: General Mental Ability
questions.text: A train 180 meters long is traveling at a speed of 54 km/hr. How much time will it take to pass an electric pole?
questions.explanation: $54\text{ km/h} = 54 \times 5/18 = 15\text{ m/s}$. Time $= 180 / 15 = 12\text{ seconds}$.
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: General Mental Ability
questions.text: The average age of 24 students in a classroom is 15 years. If the teacher's age is included, the average increases by 1 year. What is the teacher's age?
questions.explanation: Total age of 24 students $= 24 \times 15 = 360$. Total age of 25 people $= 25 \times 16 = 400$. Teacher $= 400 - 360 = 40\text{ years}$.
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: General Mental Ability
questions.text: If the ratio of two numbers is 3 : 5 and their sum is 240, what is the larger number?
questions.explanation: Parts $= 3 + 5 = 8$. One part $= 240 / 8 = 30$. Larger number $= 5 \times 30 = 150$.
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: General Mental Ability
questions.text: A car covers first 60 km at 30 km/hr and the next 60 km at 60 km/hr. What is the average speed of the car for the entire 120 km trip?
questions.explanation: $\text{Average speed} = \frac{2uv}{u+v} = \frac{2 \times 30 \times 60}{30 + 60} = \frac{3600}{90} = 40\text{ km/hr}$.
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: General Mental Ability
questions.text: In a village election between two candidates, the winner polled 65% of the total votes and won by a majority of 600 votes. How many total votes were polled?
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: General Mental Ability
questions.text: In a circular pie chart representing a state budget expenditure, the sector for 'Education' has an angle of 72 degrees. What percentage of the budget is spent on Education?
questions.explanation: Percentage $= (72 / 360) \times 100 = 20\%$.
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: General Mental Ability
questions.text: If the Mean of a dataset is 28 and the Median is 30, what is the empirical Mode according to Karl Pearson's formula?
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: General Mental Ability
questions.text: Which measure of central tendency is LEAST affected by extreme outlier values in a skewed income distribution?
questions.explanation: The Median represents the middle positional value and is robust against extreme outliers.
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: General Mental Ability
questions.text: The Coefficient of Variation (CV) of two crop yield series A and B are 18% and 26% respectively. Which series exhibits greater consistency?

options.label: D
options.text: Cannot be determined without knowing the sample size

questions.explanation: A lower Coefficient of Variation ($CV = \sigma / \bar{x} \times 100$) indicates greater consistency and lower dispersion.
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: General Mental Ability
questions.text: In a bar chart comparing district pulses production, District A produces 120 tonnes in 2023 and 150 tonnes in 2024. What is the percentage increase in production?
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: General Mental Ability
questions.text: A bag contains 5 red balls, 4 blue balls, and 3 green balls. If one ball is drawn at random, what is the probability that it is blue?
questions.explanation: Total balls $= 5 + 4 + 3 = 12$. Blue balls $= 4$. Probability $= 4 / 12 = 1/3$.
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: General Mental Ability
questions.text: What is the Standard Deviation of the set of numbers: 5, 5, 5, 5, 5?
questions.explanation: Since all values are identical to the mean, there is zero dispersion: $\text{Standard Deviation} = 0$.
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: General Mental Ability
questions.text: What is the median of the following set of observations: 12, 7, 19, 4, 15, 9, 21?
questions.explanation: Arranged in ascending order: 4, 7, 9, 12, 15, 19, 21. Middle (4th) observation is 12.
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: General Mental Ability
questions.text: Which graphical representation is used to display continuous grouped frequency data where bars touch each other without gaps?
questions.explanation: A histogram displays continuous class interval data with contiguous adjacent rectangles.
questions.label: PYQ

questions.subject: General Mental Ability
questions.text: In a village survey of 500 households, 300 own cattle and 250 own sheep. If 100 households own both, how many households own NEITHER cattle nor sheep?
questions.explanation: $\text{Total owning either} = 300 + 250 - 100 = 450$. Owning neither $= 500 - 450 = 50$.
questions.label: PYQ
